explication: cc-connect connects chat platforms and a web dashboard to local coding agents, routing user requests into project-specific sessions and returning agent output to the initiating channel. The main runtime also exposes management, scheduled automation, webhooks, and a browser-based control surface. The README excerpt confirms the local-project chat workflow and broad platform support; sampled source confirms startup wiring, the web API client, bridge socket, and webhook behavior. Platform and agent internals are represented by their source directories because their implementations were not sampled.
